title: The Isolated Marine Sanctuary Point
statement:
Given an N x N grid containing only 0 (water) and 1 (land), find a water cell such that its distance to the nearest land cell is maximized, and return this maximum Manhattan distance.
Distance between (x0, y0) and (x1, y1) is |x0 - x1| + |y0 - y1|.
If no land or water exists in the grid, return -1.
inputFormat:
First line: Integer N.
Next N lines: N space-separated integers (0 or 1).

sampleCases.explanation: Center cell (1, 1) is at distance 2 from all corner land cells.
Bottom-right cell (2, 2) is at distance 4 from (0, 0).
